description: The image displays a set of four pie charts comparing the distribution of response categories for four different language models: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. There is no separate legend provided; instead, all category labels, raw counts, and percentages are positioned directly inside their respective slices. None of the slices are exploded, offset, or bolded. The top-left chart for GPT4-o consists of two slices: a dominant red slice labeled "Lack of Knowledge" representing 5 (83.3%) and a smaller light orange slice for "Safety" at 1 (16.7%). The top-right chart for Gemini1.5 contains five slices arranged clockwise in descending order of size starting from the right: a light orange slice for "Misinformation" at 33 (38.4%), a dark blue slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 19 (22.1%), a light blue slice for "Ethical Advice" at 14 (16.3%), a pale yellow slice for "Clarification" at 12 (14.0%), and a red slice for "Safety" at 8 (9.3%). The bottom-left chart for Llama3.1-70B-Instruct features two slices: a light orange slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 3 (75.0%) and a red slice for "Clarification" at 1 (25.0%). Finally, the bottom-right chart for Llama3.1-405B-Instruct is divided into two equal slices: a red slice for "Misinformation" at 2 (50.0%) and a light orange slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 2 (50.0%).
